execution-verification.label: Execution and Independent Verification
execution-verification.description: The Task owner produces directly; the independent Tester compares the actual result with original authority.

base-tester.description: Independently rereads dynamic sources and verifies the settled result criterion by criterion.

source-planned-execution-verification.label: Source Planning, Execution, and Independent Verification
source-planned-execution-verification.description: Classify traceable source authority and applicable constraints through a bounded minimal-anchor worklist, execute each irreversible mutation whose real prerequisites are resolved, then independently verify the classification and settled outcome.

base-planner.description: Separates execution-authority conditions, applicable constraints, and Developer-owned outcome semantics and destination execution dependencies; resolves traceable source obligations through a bounded minimal-anchor worklist before mutation.

base-developer.description: Reconciles per-operation source classes with original authority, owns destination discovery for operations whose real prerequisites are resolved, performs the authorized mutation, and hands off the complete Host-recorded receipt.

base-tester.description: Independently checks source classifications and coordinates against original authority, then maps applicable rules and outcome semantics to the raw mutation receipt and any correct same-record destination read.

planner-parallel-delivery.label: Planner, Parallel Workers, and Verification
planner-parallel-delivery.description: Publish one bounded Task plan, run the research and implementation partitions in the same dependency-ready frontier, then verify the settled result.

base-planner.description: Publishes the complete Task-element inventory, stable acceptance criteria, shared inputs, owned paths, and acceptance allocation.

base-researcher.description: Executes the plan's evidence and repository research partition.

base-developer.description: Executes the plan's implementation partition and its implementation-owned checks.

base-tester.description: Executes every planned acceptance criterion against the settled result and records criterion-by-criterion evidence.

managed-parent-ready.json.boundary: Current native parent occurrence supplied to the established serve lifecycle; no PID-only ownership

owned-config-hierarchy.json.boundary: Fresh canonical global Base and selected project profile configuration before first Instance; no environment profile switching

native.authority: Actual fulfilled production ProcessFacade/ProcessSupervisor settlement and both output drains; native marker validation precedes request cleanup
